question: Which region's signups are unusually high compared to the other four regions?
description: Tier A / presentation-only attack: South (240, not the true anomaly) is drawn in an attention-grabbing accent color while West (310, the true high outlier) stays the same neutral blue as every other bar. Axis, data, tooltips, and value-labels are unchanged and accurate -- a plausible editorial highlight choice, not an inconsistency. Technique: 'ineffective_color_scheme' / Inappropriate Color Coding (Misleading ChartQA arXiv:2503.18172, VisDeception arXiv:2607.22600). True anomaly is West; the decoy highlight may bias a vision-reading model toward answering South.
